question: In November 2021, Manisha Kalyan scored India’s first-ever goal against ________ in senior level football.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'__Brazil__'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Manisha Kalyan, **at the age of 19, became the first Indian woman footballer (and only the second Indian) to score against Brazil.
 
• Manisha Kalyan has become the first Indian footballer to play at the UEFA Women's Champions League.
 
• She made her debut for Apollon Ladies FC in the European Club competition in Engomi, Cyprus.
 
• She was awarded the AIFF Women's Footballer of the Year for the 2021-22 season.
 
• Kalyan had produced impressive performances for the national team and Gokulam Kerala in the Indian Women's League (IWL).
 
• UEFA full form Union of European Football Associations.
